tips.summary: Paste over a selection p / P
details: Select, then p drops your yank in
p swaps the old text into your yank
P keeps your yank for the next spot
v selects characters
V selects whole lines
Ctrl-v selects a block
o moves cursor to the other end
Grow or trim the start from there

tips.summary: Swap corner in Visual block O
details: Ctrl-v starts the block
O hops to the other end of the row
Now grow it from that side

tips.summary: Select the last change you made
details: `[ jumps to the change start
v then `] reaches the end
Esc dropped it? gv brings it back
Then act on it again, like y or >
/foo, then gn selects the match
Attach an operator: dgn, cgn, ygn
gN grabs the previous match
Select lines, then run :sort
Use :sort u to keep unique lines
:sort n sorts by number
vi( grabs the text inside parens
vip grabs the whole paragraph
Swap i for a to include the edges
gg goes top, V starts linewise
G extends to end of file
> indents, < outdents
Then press . to repeat
> on a selection drops it
>gv indents and reselects
<gv does the same outdenting

tips.summary: Change case of a selection u / U
details: Select, then u makes it lowercase
U makes it uppercase, ~ flips it
Select text then press gq
Runs the IDE code reformat

tips.summary: Type on many lines at once Ctrl-v
details: Ctrl-v, j to span lines, then I
Type, then Esc fills every line
$A instead adds at each line end

tips.summary: Replace a block on many lines
details: Ctrl-v and hjkl mark the block
Press c, type the new text
Esc fills every line

tips.summary: Fill a block with one char r
details: Ctrl-v starts Visual Block mode
hjkl extends the block
rx fills every cell with x
Select lines, press :, type s/a/b/
Enter edits only the selected lines
